panelTitle: The last few days have been hard
panelBody: You've been outside your goal for a few days. This is a chance to learn how to start again.

intro.title: Starting again is a skill
intro.body: Most people try a few times before a change sticks. Each attempt teaches you what works.

learned.title: What you've learned along the way
learned.triggers: The situations you struggled with most: {list}
learned.none: Not enough entries yet. Your future entries will guide you.

goal.title: Review your goal
goal.hint: Changing your goal isn't a step back. Maybe a cut-down goal is more realistic right now; the decision is yours.

restart.title: Continue from the Boundaries phase
restart.body: You restart your programme from the Boundaries phase (day 8): we'll reorganise your environment and risky hours together. Your total days, longest streak and the urge moments you managed are kept.
restart.done: You're ready. Your programme continues from the Boundaries phase.
